definitions.explanation: A device or app that counts the number of steps a person takes. Used for health and fitness tracking.

examples.japanese: {歩数計|ほすうけい}を{付|つ}けて{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I walk with a pedometer on.

examples.japanese: スマホの{歩数計|ほすうけい}で{毎日|まいにち}の{歩数|ほすう}を{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: I record my daily steps with my smartphone's pedometer.

examples.japanese: {歩数計|ほすうけい}を{見|み}たら{今日|きょう}は{一万歩|いちまんぽ}も{歩|ある}いていた。
examples.english: When I checked my pedometer, I had walked as many as 10,000 steps today.

notes:
Composed of {歩数|ほすう} (step count) + {計|けい} (meter/gauge). Refers to any device or app that counts steps.

USAGE:
Originally a standalone clip-on device, now commonly a built-in feature of smartphones and smartwatches. Still widely used in Japan, where the {一万歩|いちまんぽ} (10,000 steps per day) health goal remains popular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}アプリ: pedometer app
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}を{付|つ}ける: to wear a pedometer
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}で{測|はか}る: to measure with a pedometer

RELATED 〜{計|けい} WORDS:
- {体温計|たいおんけい}: thermometer (body temperature)
- {体重計|たいじゅうけい}: bathroom scale
- {万歩計|まんぽけい}: pedometer (brand name, very common synonym)
